title: E-commerce Flash Sale
prompt: Design the backend for a flash sale: 10,000 units of a product go on sale at noon and millions of users try to buy at the same second.
functionalReqs: Users attempt to buy during the sale window
Users learn quickly whether they got one
Unpaid orders release stock after a timeout
nonFunctionalReqs: Rest of the site stays up
deepDives: Static page + CDN for the sale page
